messages:
Maya: Quick non-work poll: you find one extra free minute each morning. Do you spend it lying in bed (snooze) or getting up early to watch the sunrise? Vote + one-line reason.
Jamal: Sunrise 5 5. Coffee + sky colors = instant mood boost.
Ana: Lie-in. I need the extra 10 for brain boot. :sleeping:
Ravi: Sunrise on weekends, lie-in weekdays. If forced: sunrise for fresh air.
Lena: Lie-in. Ten more minutes under duvet = happiness.
Elliot: Sunrise. Tiny ritual that makes the day feel earned. Also photo ops.
Coffee-Bot: Tally: sunrise 3, lie-in 2. Proposed ritual: sunrise + pour-over.
Maya: Add a micro-ritual if sunrise, or a snooze trick if lie-in.
Tina: Lie-in with one-snooze rule: set alarm, allow one snooze, then up. Works wonders.
Jamal: Sunrise ritual = 2-min balcony silence, no phone.
Ana: Snooze trick = phone across the room so you actually get up to turn it off.
Ravi: Weekend sunrise = 10-min jog to a viewpoint + black coffee.
Lena: Pro tip: lamp timer to simulate sunrise, eases wake-up.
Elliot: Can someone add these to the "micro-rituals" wiki? :raised_hands:
Maya: Tiny follow-up: who actually watches a real sunrise more than once a month? Yes/no.
Jamal: yes 5 (summer).
Ana: no, only on vacation.
Ravi: yes on hikes, no on weekdays.
Lena: no.
Elliot: weekend-only yes.
Tina: no but trying the one-snooze tomorrow. Report to follow.
Coffee-Bot: Reminder set: Tomorrow 06:40 "tiny sunrise + pour-over?" opt-in.
Maya: Results: sunrise wins among volunteers; lie-in wins for weekdays. Thanks all!
